ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Allow tracking so the ads in Dogs Out match your interests. The ads keep Dogs Out free; your choice changes nothing else in the app.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Dogs Out uses your location to show dogs, playdates and sitters near you. Others only see how far away you are.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Dogs Out needs access to your photos so you can add pictures of yourself and your dog.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Dogs Out adds playdates you save to your calendar.
ios.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Dogs Out adds playdates you save to your calendar.
